business_problem: Burberry's daily clickstream batches arrived too late and its prior warehouse pre-aggregated the data, making it hard to trust granular customer-behavior details or personalize service for webrooming shoppers in time.
solution_summary: Burberry paired Snowplow's Behavioral Data Platform with the Databricks Data + AI Platform to replace slow daily clickstream batches from its prior warehouse with a near-real-time customer 360. Clickstream events from Burberry.com flow into Snowplow, where digital-touchpoint behavior is captured and privacy controls, consent tracking and server-side cookies are managed. The data then lands in Databricks, where 40 personalized models recalculate recommendations, propensity scores and lifetime value before sending outputs to the retailer's action system and in-store advisors. Burberry also uses the dbt plug-in for Databricks to enrich referral, consent-banner and server-side cookie data so marketing attribution reflects owned behavioral data instead of coarse pre-aggregations. This architecture lets store staff act on opted-in shoppers' most recent online behavior during the same webrooming journey.
